<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🎙️ Your First Voice Bot</h3><a id="user-content-️-your-first-voice-bot" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🎙️ Your First Voice Bot" href="#️-your-first-voice-bot"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Open <a href="http://localhost:3010" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:3010</a> in your browser.</li>
<li>Pick <strong>Inbound</strong> or <strong>Outbound</strong>, name your bot (e.g. <em>Lead Qualification</em>), and describe the use case in 5–10 words (e.g. <em>Screen insurance form submissions for purchase intent</em>).</li>
<li>Click <strong>Test Agent</strong>.</li>
<li>Use <strong>Test Audio</strong> to talk to your agent in the browser, or <strong>Test Chat</strong> to iterate faster in text. In Test Chat, you can edit or replay user turns and Dograh will regenerate the agent's replies and node transitions from that point.</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">🔑 <strong>No API keys needed.</strong> Dograh ships with auto-generated keys and its own LLM / TTS / STT stack. Connect your own keys for LLM, TTS, STT, or Telephony (e.g. Twilio, Vonage, Telnyx) anytime.</p>
</blockquote>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Build Agents with MCP</h2><a id="user-content-build-agents-with-mcp" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Build Agents with MCP" href="#build-agents-with-mcp"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Dograh ships with an MCP server, so coding agents can work directly inside your Dograh workspace.</p>
<p dir="auto">Connect Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client to inspect existing agents, search Dograh docs, fetch node schemas, create new workflows, and save draft edits from natural language.</p>
<p dir="auto">When asking your coding agent to build a voice agent, share a short script for
the use case instead of only a one-line prompt. Include the agent persona, call
flow, rules, objection handling, success criteria, and a sample conversation if
